meta.name: build-agents-index
meta.description: Scan all agent and sub-agent definition files in .gaai/core/agents/, extract YAML frontmatter, merge with specialists.registry.yaml, and generate a derived agents-index.yaml at .gaai/core/agents/agents-index.yaml. Activate after adding, modifying, or removing any agent, sub-agent, or specialist entry.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 自动扫描 agent 文件，生成最新索引
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果你需要自动维护 agent 索引文件
copy.tagline_en: Scan agent files and generate updated index automatically
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to keep agent index up to date

howto.what: 装上后，Claude 会扫描所有智能体和子智能体的定义文件，提取它们的设置信息（如角色、ID 等），再合并专家注册表，自动生成一个汇总索引文件 agents-index.yaml。
howto.when: 在你添加、修改或删除了智能体、子智能体或专家条目后，或者索引文件不存在或可能过期时触发。

say.note: Claude 会扫描文件并生成最新索引。

say.text: 我改了一个智能体的角色，更新索引。

howto.what_en: After installation, Claude will scan all agent and sub-agent definition files, extract their YAML frontmatter (role, ID, etc.), merge with the specialists registry, and automatically generate a derived index file agents-index.yaml that aggregates all agents and specialists.
howto.when_en: Triggers after you add, modify, or remove an agent, sub-agent, or specialist entry, or when the index file is missing or suspected stale.

say_en.note: Claude scans files and produces the latest index.

say_en.text: I changed an agent's role, update the index.
